cards.title: Whole division with //
cards.body: `/` gives a decimal: `7 / 2` is `3.5`. `//` keeps only the whole part: `7 // 2` is `3`.

hi.title: // se whole division
hi.body: `/` decimal deta hai: `7 / 2` ka matlab `3.5`. `//` sirf whole part rakhta hai: `7 // 2` ka matlab `3`.

cards.title: The remainder with %
cards.body: `%` gives what is left over after whole division. 7 split into groups of 2 leaves 1 over.

hi.title: % se remainder
hi.body: `%` batata hai whole division ke baad kitna bacha. 7 ko 2-2 ke groups mein baanto toh 1 bachta hai.

cards.title: Printing several values
cards.body: Give `print()` several values separated by commas and it puts one space between each.

hi.title: Kai values print karna
hi.body: `print()` ko commas se alag karke kai values do, woh har value ke beech ek space daal deta hai.

cards.title: Spot the bug
cards.body: For 150 minutes it should print `2 30`, but it prints `2.5 30`. Which line is wrong?
cards.code:
minutes = int(input())
hours = minutes / 60
left = minutes % 60
print(hours, left)

bug.fix: `/` gives a decimal like `2.5`. Whole hours need floor division: `minutes // 60`.

hi.title: Bug dhoondo
hi.body: 150 minutes ke liye isse `2 30` print karna chahiye, par yeh `2.5 30` print karta hai. Kaunsi line galat hai?
hi.fix: `/` decimal deta hai jaise `2.5`. Whole hours ke liye floor division chahiye: `minutes // 60`.

check.question: What does this print?
check.explanation: 100 // 60 is 1 whole hour, and 100 % 60 is the 40 minutes left over.

hi.question: Yeh kya print karega?
hi.explanation: 100 // 60 matlab 1 poora ghanta, aur 100 % 60 matlab bache hue 40 minutes.

exercise.prompt: Read a number of minutes and print it as `H h M min`. Use `//` for the whole hours and `%` for the minutes left over. For `135`, print `2 h 15 min`
exercise.promptHi: Minutes ki ek sankhya padho aur use `H h M min` ki tarah print karo. Poore ghanton ke liye `//` aur bache minutes ke liye `%` use karo. `135` ke liye `2 h 15 min` print karo.
